rule: score(candidate) = mean over the shot's characters of cosine(ArcFace(front-view face of the character sheet), max over the candidate's faces of ArcFace(face)); characters either picture does not show are left out; the highest score wins; a shot with no scored character keeps its current version
bar: ranks the right person above the wrong one in at least 90 % of pairs (ADR-0112's ranking bar: at most 10 % wrong)
corpus: continuity corpus 2 (/var/tmp/ar9b/cj-corpus2): 8 stories, 38 right-person frames and 38 look-alike frames drawn with local FLUX.2 klein 4B in the same place and beat
note: As a gate it is weak (at 0.29 every look-alike is caught but 27 % of right frames fail); it is used to rank candidates only.
